# Rejected comparison skin — not used by the current player

This source contains a painted black eye and lip injury. It is retained only
for provenance of the rejected test. The active clean source is `../skin_toigo/`.

# Aksel skin source for offline baking

Author: **Mindfront**. Asset: `mindfront_aksel_skin` / Aksel skin.
License: **CC0**, as explicitly listed by the official MakeHuman Community
Natural male skins pack. `LICENSE_EVIDENCE.md` preserves that published table.

- Pack page: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins02.html
- Archive: https://files.makehumancommunity.org/asset_packs/skins02/skins02_cc0.zip
- Original asset page: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/850
- Retrieved 2026-10-18. CRC checks matched the original ZIP entries; SHA256
  hashes and member paths are in `provenance.json`.

The unchanged diffuse/normal maps are anatomical skin source art. They are
resampled through the original MakeHuman UV islands into the game's smaller
head/body maps, then colour-tuned. They do not define Shane's identity or
replace the geometry/reference matching work. The original source images
remain outside Godot's runtime asset tree. No tattooed or bearded skin was
selected, and the archive's other assets are not vendored here.
